decks.notes: This deck aims to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty using cards like Entomb and Faithless Looting. By utilizing reanimation spells such as Reanimate and Animate Dead, the deck can bring these creatures back onto the battlefield for a devastating early game advantage. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with high-powered threats before they have a chance to react, ultimately securing a quick victory through the power of graveyard manipulation and reanimation.

The deck focuses on aggressively utilizing artifacts in combination with blue spells to control the board and overwhelm the opponent. With a variety of artifact creatures and powerful artifacts like Chalice of the Void and Urza's Saga, the deck can quickly establish a strong presence on the battlefield. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Thought Monitor provide card advantage and utility, while cards like Force of Will offer protection. The synergy between artifact creatures and spells allows for a versatile and aggressive playstyle, aiming to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent.

The deck revolves around assembling the Cephalid Breakfast combo, using Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to mill your library and then sacrificing Narcomoeba to trigger Dread Return and bring back Thassa's Oracle to win the game. The deck also uses Stoneforge Mystic to find the necessary equipment, Force of Will to protect the combo, and various cantrips to dig for key pieces. The deck's goal is to assemble the combo quickly while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal spells.

The deck focuses on using a variety of spells to control the game, with a mix of removal, counterspells, and card draw. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining card advantage through efficient spells like Prismatic Ending and Force of Will. The deck also utilizes powerful creatures like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Endurance to pressure the opponent while providing additional value. The mana base is carefully constructed to support a variety of powerful spells and ensure consistent access to all colors of mana.

The main concept of this deck revolves around utilizing cards like Dark Ritual, Doomsday, Thassa's Oracle, and Street Wraith to set up a game-winning combo as quickly and efficiently as possible. By efficiently searching for and deploying key cards, while also disrupting opponents with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze, this deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game in a single turn. The inclusion of cards like Personal Tutor and Thoughtseize further enhance the deck's ability to find and protect its win condition while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly put powerful creatures such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand into play using the card Show and Tell, bypassing their high mana costs. The deck includes ways to protect this strategy with counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce, as well as the ability to cheat in creatures with Sneak Attack. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with these powerful creatures before they have a chance to respond effectively.

This deck focuses on utilizing Aether Vial to cheat out creatures and disrupt opponents with cards like Spell Pierce and Force of Will. The key strategy involves flickering creatures like Baleful Strix and Gilded Drake to control the board and generate advantage. The deck also uses Teferi, Time Raveler to bounce problematic permanents and protect its own threats. With a mix of disruptive spells and powerful creatures, the deck aims to apply consistent pressure and outvalue opponents in the long game.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Death's Shadow and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will. It also utilizes efficient spells like Brainstorm and Daze to maintain tempo advantage. The mana base includes fetch lands to ensure consistent access to the necessary colors of mana. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure and disrupt the opponent's strategy in order to secure a victorious outcome.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish early board presence with aggressive creatures like Archon of Emeria and White Plume Adventurer, while controlling the opponent's board with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Solitude. The deck aims to maintain the initiative by utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Emeria's Call to maintain pressure on the opponent. Additionally, the deck utilizes mana acceleration through Chrome Mox, Lotus Petal, and lands like City of Traitors to quickly cast its spells and overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish an aggressive board presence and maintain control of the game through disruption and removal spells. By utilizing cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Elite Spellbinder to slow down opponents, while deploying creatures like White Plume Adventurer and Palace Jailer to pressure them, the deck aims to control the tempo of the game and close out matches quickly. With a mix of powerful creatures and disruptive spells, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents and secure victories through a combination of early aggression and resource denial.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategy by playing aggressive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Elite Spellbinder. The deck also includes cards like Chalice of the Void and Palace Jailer to control the game and protect its own creatures. With cards like Solitude and Ephemerate for additional removal and protection, and cards like Ancient Tomb and Chrome Mox for ramp, this deck aims to pressure the opponent early and maintain the upper hand throughout the game.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive threats like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent while disrupting opponents with counterspells like Daze and Force of Will. The key strategy is to maintain tempo through card advantage with cards like Brainstorm and Expressive Iteration, while also utilizing efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Abrade. The deck aims to quickly close out games by applying pressure and disrupting opponents' game plans, making it difficult for them to stabilize and turn the game in their favor.

The main focus of this deck is to maintain control over the game tempo by utilizing efficient creatures and spells to quickly pressure opponents while disrupting their game plan with counterspells and land destruction. The deck aims to deploy threats like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent early on, while using cards like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning to finish off opponents. By combining aggressive creatures with disruptive spells and efficient card draw, this deck aims to outpace and overwhelm opponents in the Legacy format.

The primary focus of this deck is to control the opponent's resources and game plan through a combination of curses and powerful artifacts. By using cards like Curse of Misfortunes to find key curses, along with disruptive elements like Trinisphere and Leyline of the Void, this deck aims to lock down the opponent's options and win conditions. Karn, the Great Creator provides additional utility in fetching artifacts, while cards like Sudden Edict and Cruel Reality offer targeted removal and punishment for the opponent. The deck's main strategy revolves around manipulating the game to its advantage through a combination of curses and control elements.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, then use cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring them back onto the battlefield for a powerful combo. The deck includes a lot of cards that allow for fast and efficient graveyard manipulation, as well as disruption in the form of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Unmask. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with big threats early in the game and win quickly.

The main focus of this Grixis Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through the use of counterspells, removal spells, hand disruption, and card advantage. The deck looks to control the board with creatures like Baleful Strix and Snapcaster Mage while also utilizing powerful cards like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to grind out value over the course of the game. This deck aims to outlast the opponent with its versatile answers and strong threats, making it a formidable force in the Legacy format.
